add_symbols_to_trace_symbol_table: add symbols to a TraceSymbolTable using add_symbols or add_symbols_mp for multiprocessing
create_trace_symbol_table_from_dataframe: create a TraceSymbolTable from a pandas DataFrame using create_from_df
encode_decode_dataframe_with_symbol_tabl: encode DataFrame string columns to integer IDs and decode back using encode_df and decode_df
find_matched_symbols_in_trace_symbol_tab: find symbols matching a regex pattern using find_matched_symbols and find_matches
combine_and_clone_trace_symbol_tables: combine multiple TraceSymbolTables into one or clone an existing table
